validity.researcher_notes: gem.wiki returned HTTP 403 to WebFetch (Cloudflare) so wiki_citations.json was empty for this row, per scope notes; skipped straight to open-web research. WebSearch tool budget was exhausted for this session, so I used WebFetch on DuckDuckGo/Bing HTML result pages plus direct curl against candidate primary-source URLs. Found SNGPL's own official 'Transmission System' network-inventory page (sngpl.com.pk, article id 341 under pgids=461), which is a segment-by-segment asset register of SNGPL's entire gas transmission grid, broken out by province with subtotals and a grand total (9538.675 km). In the PUNJAB section (row 176) it lists 'WAH - NOWSHERA (2)', diameter 16 (inches, matching GEM's Diameter/DiameterUnits column), length 52.60 km -- an EXACT match to GEM's current LengthKnown (52.60) and Diameter (16 in) for P4173. This is a strong existence confirmation: the pipeline is a named, itemized asset in SNGPL's own network register, not a GEM-only entity. It also confirms classification (this table IS the transmission system, so PipelineType=transmission is correct, not a gathering/feeder line) and attribution (SNGPL is literally the utility whose own asset register this is, so Owner1=Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Ltd (SNGPL) 100% is correct; the segment name 'WAH-NOWSHERA' also confirms the StartLocation=Wah/EndLocation=Nowshera pairing and that it crosses from Punjab (Wah, Rawalpindi district) into Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (Nowshera), matching GEM's province fields on both ends). Duplicate check against the 63-row roster: P4170 (Wah-Nowshera Gas Pipeline I, 10in, 50.41 km) is the SIBLING loop line, not a re-count of P4173 -- the SNGPL table lists both 'WAH - NOWSHERA (1)' (10in, 50.41 km, row 175) and 'WAH - NOWSHERA (2)' (16in, 52.60 km, row 176) as two separate, co-located parallel lines, exactly mirroring GEM's two separate rows. No duplicate concern. A related spec caveat (probable length undercount) is flagged separately below. English-language source only; did not find Urdu-language independent coverage beyond SNGPL's own bilingual site.

validity.researcher_notes: The SNGPL transmission-system table used to confirm existence/spec above (sngpl.com.pk, article id 341) lists 'WAH - NOWSHERA (2)' twice: once in the PUNJAB section (row 176: 16in, 52.60 km -- the figure that matches GEM's current LengthKnown exactly) and again in the KPK section (row 6: 16in, 23.68 km). The same pattern recurs for the sibling line ('WAH - NOWSHERA (1)': 50.41 km in Punjab / 25.13 km in KPK) and for 'WAH-HATTAR' (6.17+9.93 km in Punjab / 13.62 km in KPK), which strongly indicates SNGPL's register itemizes each named cross-province route by province for asset-accounting purposes, and that GEM's value has only ever captured the Punjab-side portion of this specific route. If that reading is correct, GEM's LengthKnown for P4173 (52.60 km) understates the true end-to-end Wah(Punjab)-to-Nowshera(KP) route length by roughly 23.68 km (total ~76.28 km). This is currently only a single-source (SNGPL) finding -- I could not get a second independent source to corroborate the province-split total before WebSearch's session budget was exhausted and DuckDuckGo/Mojeek began CAPTCHA-blocking WebFetch requests -- so I am flagging it as a concern for human verification rather than proposing a specific corrected value.
